correctness.rationale: The exhaustive support stratification handles sizes one through six, including the torus via the nonsingular cycle-adjacency linear system, and gives an explicit irredundant union of two planes and eighteen lines. Five rational Hessian witnesses represent all symmetry orbits, with exact nonzero maximal minors and a general upper rank bound from the tangent cone. The holomorphic Morse–Bott lemma then proves the generic analytic normal forms. Exact parameter-polynomial gradient identities on all twenty spaces and rational matrix ranks replay with the standalone verify.py. Intersection cases are explicitly excluded.
